title: OneDrive on the web: Copilot creates a presentation from a Word file
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap's stale target and development status, and its licence-assignment path and PowerShell command match Microsoft documentation. Searches confirmed the narrowly stated gaps about the planned OneDrive action; documentation for PowerPoint and the Copilot app does not establish this action's implementation.
